newsitem.title: USA: US local economies strong, labor tight - Fed banks.
newsitem.headline: US local economies strong, labor tight - Fed banks.

text.p: A close look at six of the 12 U.S. economic districts suggests the nation's economy appears to be headed for another year of firm economic growth in 1997, regional Federal Reserve bank officials said.
But the six regional Fed economists recently interviewed for this article warned about continued tight local labor markets and scattered wage pressures.
The sentiment from local Fed officials provides some hints at which direction the nation's economy as a whole is moving, analysts said.
